Why? Maybe the action() call only executed 10 out of 11. Or maybe there was a frame/animation issue. Let me check: "the code executed 10 actions in the previous sequence." So only 10 were executed. Maybe the batch got truncated, or the last action was dropped.
Hmm, actually wait. Let me reconsider. Maybe the game executed all 11, but the final UP moved L from (14,19) to (9,19), and then... no, the current eyes are (14,19) and (9,39), so L is still at (14,19). So the final UP wasn't applied.
Let me reconsider: maybe action() has a limit, or the 11th action was a no-op that got discarded. Or maybe there's an issue with batching more than 10 actions.
Anyway, the current state: L(14,19), R(9,39). I just need to do one more UP to get L to (9,19), R(9,39) — the symmetric top. Let me do that and check.
Actually wait, but the level didn't complete at step 10 (L(14,19), R(9,39)) — that makes sense since they're not both at the top yet. Let me do the final UP.
But actually, let me reconsider whether the win condition is really "both at the top." I'm about to reach (9,19),(9,39). If the level completes, my hypothesis is confirmed. If not, I need to reconsider.
Let me do the final UP and check.
